title: Night-Sky Weave
summary: Nine chunky reversible constellation tiles whose centered starlight gates flow into snowflakes, dragons, crowns, and imaginary night-sky patterns, then return to a pocket-size three-by-three mosaic.
material_assumption: Common rigid FDM filament such as PLA or PETG; no purchased hardware.
print_assumption: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.20 mm layers, flat on the broad face, no supports; slice three copies of each single-body family STL. The assembled STL is a review/storage layout, not a print target.
limitations: No successful physical print, durability test, or human playtest is claimed.
Tiles register by loose edge placement and do not lock together.
